meta.title: Service Launch Explorer
meta.eyebrow: FROM CUSTOMER NEED TO A CLEAR SERVICE
meta.headline: A clearer path from first request to
meta.intro: Explore the people, work and capabilities behind a fictional service launch. Replace this example with the new subject and its verified sources.
meta.evidenceBoundary: Illustrative content only. No customer research, approved policy, measured outcomes or implemented system is claimed.

paths.title: Customer
paths.summary: From an initial request to a supported outcome.

stages.title: Understand
stages.summary: Clarify the request and its owner.
stages.goal: Turn an initial request into a shared understanding.
stages.action: Confirm the requested outcome, missing information and accountable coordinator.
stages.decision: Is the request ready to plan or does it need clarification?
stages.handoff: The coordinator receives a complete request and an agreed next action.
stages.finding: Illustrative hypothesis: unclear ownership can create repeated questions.
stages.openQuestion: Validate the minimum intake information with real users.

details.title: Acceptance direction
details.body: A complete request exposes the outcome, owner and next action.

stages.title: Plan
stages.summary: Agree scope and the next commitment.
stages.goal: Create a plan that the customer and delivery team can review.
stages.action: Review scope, dependencies and the next commitment.
stages.decision: Can the request proceed under the agreed service boundary?
stages.handoff: The delivery owner accepts the documented plan.
stages.openQuestion: Confirm approval rights and the fallback for missing information.

stages.title: Handoff
stages.summary: Confirm the outcome and next owner.
stages.action: Record what was delivered, unresolved work and who receives it.
stages.decision: Is the handoff complete or does it need follow-up?
stages.handoff: The receiving team acknowledges the next action.

stages.title: Triage
stages.summary: Route the request to an accountable owner.
stages.action: Confirm ownership and route unresolved assignments to review.
stages.handoff: The owner receives the request and a clear next action.

people.name: Service coordinator
people.mission: Keep the request and its next owner connected.
people.context: Fictional role model for illustrating the layout.
people.scope: One request, from receipt to an acknowledged handoff.
people.home: A work list with the request, missing information, owner and next action.
questions: What information is most often missing?

jobs.title: Clarify the next action
jobs.statement: When a request is incomplete, I want to identify the missing information and its owner so work can move forward.

steps.title: Review the request
steps.friction: An unclear request may be routed repeatedly.
steps.action: Check the requested outcome and minimum information.
steps.proposed: Show the missing information and next accountable owner.
steps.handoff: The selected owner receives the request.
steps.check: A complete request has one owner and one next action.
steps.openQuestion: Validate this scenario with a role holder.

modules.title: Clear intake and ownership
modules.fit: A shared work list with explicit routing
modules.goal: Give each request an accountable owner and a visible next step.
experience: Review the request, see missing information and identify its owner.
records: Request, owner, outcome and next action.
build: Choose tooling after the workflow and source of truth are confirmed.
questions: Who can assign or redirect a request?
checks: An incomplete request is returned with a clear reason and next action.
modules.capabilityNote: Illustrative design direction, not a claim about a product.

items.title: A usable request list
items.description: Show the owner, next action and missing information.
items.fallback: A reviewed list or report can support the first release.
items.dependency: Agree the minimum intake fields and assignment authority.

priorities.title: Later
priorities.description: Optional improvement after the core work is validated.

items.title: Richer prioritization
items.description: Add prioritization after learning which signals users rely on.

decisions.title: Define complete intake
decisions.question: What information is required before work can be accepted?
decisions.direction: Use a short set of fields tied to an actual decision.
decisions.gap: Validate the fields and exception route.
